skill.summary: Classify any learning activity, practice structure, or instructional design element as a desirable difficulty (strengthens encoding) or undesirable difficult...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — classifies learning activities by desirable vs. undesirable difficulty using six science-backed strategy types.

- Audits any learning design (course, training, study method) for evidence-based difficulty management.
- Identifies presence/absence of six proven strategies: spacing, interleaving, variation, retrieval, generation, elaboration.
- Produces prioritized redesign recommendations to optimize learning difficulty.
- Not for building custom study schedules or judging learner aptitude or content accuracy.
- Works from a description of learning activities; suitable for instructional designers, teachers, trainers, coaches, or self-learners.
